question: Under what temporal condition is old age and death claimed to be destroyed?
premises: The practice is carried out for one year.
When that practice has been practiced, a condition holds.
Old age and death are destroyed under that condition.
inference: When the practice has been carried out for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: The exact practice referred to is presupposed from preceding verses.
plain_english: When it has been practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
